original_test_intent: Exercise the platform-defined Speed Change 25 operation as five hundred true Gen2-to-Gen5 transitions on the mapped GB-NV-PVP PCIe path, with every transaction reaching required full width and remaining free of link and system errors.
original_method: Obtain the authoritative Speed Change 25/NVQual definition because the Procedure is only a label; prove Gen5 support and per-cycle full-width Gen2 entry; execute five hundred atomic transactions while recording request, intermediate LTSSM/equalization, settled Gen5 width, error deltas, and health; inhibit further changes at the first missing or failed result and recover out of band.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE supplies the authoritative meaning and configuration of Speed Change 25 and confirms the Gen5 path; lab personnel isolate the SUT and own console recovery.
required_inputs: Authoritative Speed Change 25/NVQual command, package, and configuration
Per-cycle Gen2/full-width entry mechanism and proof
Gen5 request/equalization/LTSSM trajectory, required width, settle and transient rules
500-count, error-delta, first-fault, final-state, and recovery policies
safety_requirements: Dedicated approved SUT with stable power/cooling and console recovery
Do not execute a label-derived or guessed command
Validate path, Gen2 start, and Gen5 capability
Stop on wrong start, unsupported target, equalization/retrain failure, reduced width, new AER, endpoint/GPU/host loss, reset, thermal/power anomaly, or logging gap
agent_execution_scope: Verify owner-supplied Speed Change 25 semantics, topology, capability, and criteria
Run only the pinned operation after approval
Persist initial/intermediate/final states and error evidence before the next cycle
Stop on first ambiguity or fault
Do not derive commands from the label, accept lower generation/width, clear evidence, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Define Speed Change 25 and approve the Gen5 path
Set start, equalization, width, timing, error, and loop acceptance
Review all 500 transactions and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Retains the Criteria-defined Gen2-to-Gen5 test while explicitly preventing a bare label from becoming a guessed executable action or weak final-state proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: Because the Procedure contains only a vendor test name, the Criteria establishes the high-level transition pair and count but not how the tool produces them. The name cannot safely determine target BDF, control primitive, or state sequence. Each counted cycle must independently show a Gen2 start and full-width Gen5 settle; otherwise a tool might simply report its current state or exercise a different generation pair. Gen5 equalization and error deltas must be recorded before another request overwrites the first marginal event, so the runner needs a fail-closed transaction boundary.
